description: Create or refresh manifest.md of an agent project: regenerates the block listing the project's skills (from skills/*/SKILL.md) and tools (from tools/bin + tools/doc/*.json) and keeps any hand-written text outside that block. Run it after adding, removing or renaming skills or tools, and before agent_build.

dir.description: Agent project directory, relative to the working directory. Default: the working directory itself.
